programme.desc: Portly Penguin. The staff battle to save a vulnerable chick, a portly penguin is put on a strict diet, and in home pen a juvenile of unknown gender gets some important test results. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Smiling Is The Best Medicine. Wayde and Brett transform a disused photo booth into an aquarium for the Las Vegas First Friday street fair, but will it be smiles all round? S3, Ep9

programme.title: Animal Cops Houston
programme.desc: From Cages to Comfort. When bears and tigers were found in a chicken shed, it was one of the most dramatic rescues ever. The team catch up with them as they enjoy new lives. S9, Ep15

programme.title: Animal Cops Houston
programme.desc: Desperate Measures. When Barney, a dog with an embedded collar, is spotted in the Houston countryside Investigator Kristi Franks is called into action and a desperate chase ensues. S11, Ep1

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Bushfire Rescue. After historical wildfires strike Australia, the Irwins race to rescue as many animals as possible. Robert and Terri help the severely injured koala population. S3, Ep3

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Face Off. Tia meets a family of eight looking to adopt a new dog after losing theirs to cancer. Plus, a rescue-call takes Tia and her daughter into New Orleans's infamous ninth ward. S4, Ep2

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Mending Willow. Willow, a young red panda, is having mysterious foot problems. And, the bird department anxiously awaits the gender reveal of two new adjutant stork chicks. S3, Ep13

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Snow Monkey Social. A new bison calf struggles to keep up with his mum. And, keepers at the Central Park Zoo hope the female snow monkeys accept a new male. S3, Ep9

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Wild Riders. Game Wardens race to confront reckless jet skiers wreaking havoc at a boat ramp. Plus, a crabber turns hostile when caught without a fishing licence. S6, Ep21

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Mile-High Mutt. A golden retriever is rushed into surgery after swallowing a pacifier. Then, when a stray dog is hit by a car in Oklahoma, Dr Jeff and his team step up to save him. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Adventure Headquarters. Pete and the team give a thrill-seeking couple their dream treehouse, straddling three cedars with a wraparound deck providing 360 degrees of stunning views. S5, Ep5

programme.title: Richard E. Grant's 7 Deadly Sins
programme.desc: Pride. Richard E Grant explores the evolutionary roots of pride. From stag beetles, to gorillas, to hyenas, do animals also display this seemingly human trait? S1, Ep6

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Thanksgiving Rescue. As Thanksgiving approaches, the Kilchers prepare for a feast. Eivin and Eve rescue a baby seal on the beach and there's a beetle infestation on the homestead. S9, Ep8

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: A New Chapter. As Ami prepares to undergo treatment for lung cancer, Bear, Bird, and Rain work to give the family's homestead back to the bush- and the wolfpack looks to the future. S3, Ep30

programme.title: Mountain Monsters
programme.desc: Wolfman of Wolfe County. The Wolfe County in Kentucky has a fresh trail of evidence that a 500 pound Wolfman is terrorizing the region. Can a group of hunters catch this monster? S1, Ep1

programme.title: Dhadkan

programme.title: Krantiveer

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil

programme.desc: A Cheetah's Greatest Race: A cheetah fights for its life against a mysterious and debilitating illness, and an elephant is artificially inseminated. (S3, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Cobra in the Kitchen: Snake catchers Simon and Siouxsie go to the rescue when the weather draws venomous snakes into homes and offices. Among them is a deadly black mamba. (S3, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Savannah Survivors: From highspeed cheetah hunts in the Karoo to deadly river crossings in the Serengeti, watch as Africa's savannah residents fight to survive. 7+ (S8, ep 2)

programme.title: Zoo: Disney's Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Giant Leap For Rhinokind: A critically endangered antelope needs urgent care, a baby rhino takes her first steps out on the savannah and a beloved manatee visits the dentist. 7+ (S2 9/10)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: All in the Farm-Ily: Leading up to the big Schroeder family dinner, Dr Ben and Dr Erin are challenged by some rare animal cases. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Wild Bhutan: The Last Shangri-La
programme.desc: ...The Last Shangri-La. Explore this Eden between Tibet and India, a place where nature and religion have combined to turn a tiny Buddhist kingdom into the world's last Shangri-La. 7+

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: Gator Country: A look at Florida's spectacular wildlife and deadly predators, including the harsh odds of survival facing a set of new-born alligator hatchlings. 7+

programme.title: Investigation Shark Attack
programme.desc: California Great Whites: Encounters with great white sharks are rising in California, and the team investigates why. Drone footage provides a window into shark behaviour. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines...
programme.desc: ...with Chris Barrie: 1980s: Chris Barrie takes a ride in a Back to the Future DeLorean DMC and revisits the battles of the Falklands War as he seeks out the greatest British machines. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: No Horsing Around: Dental damage is no trouble for an old horse with a history of being a survivor, but another pony's mysterious nosebleed needs a deeper look. (S7, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Puffin but Trouble: As keepers dream of a sand cat kitten, a nervous puffin chick learns to swim and rescued black bear cubs prepare for life outside the zoo. (S1, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Fish My City
programme.desc: Fastest Fish in Miami: In Magic City, Mike faces the tough task of catching the fastest fish in the world. He also hunts for three exotic species that are a long way from home. (S1 ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Fish My City
programme.desc: The Ragin' Cajun: Mike takes his fishing bucket list to New Orleans, where he searches the city for a fearsome prehistoric predator that can grow to ten feet long. (S1, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Fatal Consequence: Experts dissect a ferry sinking, factory blast and bridge collapse, using evidence and 3D graphics to reveal what went wrong. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Landslide Lottery: A truck and trailer carrying asphalt has crashed above a steep bank, and Thord must save it before the ground gives way and causes a mudslide. (S5, ep 4) 7+
